## Security checklist

- [ ] No runtime dependencies were added.
- [ ] No network calls, subprocesses or dynamic evaluation were added.
- [ ] Error messages and snapshots do not echo raw environment values.
- [ ] ESM, CommonJS and TypeScript declarations are in sync.
- [ ] README.md and SECURITY.md were updated if behavior or scope changed.
